source_precedence.rule: Operator corrections after the screenshot override the displayed recipe values.
The transcript supplies the research group, material stack, fabrication route, and device-family context; it does not supply a condition-matched quantitative profile.
The screenshot supplies every field not explicitly corrected by the operator.
Literature is comparison evidence only and cannot replace a missing achieved-machine observable.

adjacent_publication.relationship: Same research group and TiO2 metasurface fabrication lineage; not demonstrated to use this exact recipe or layout.

context_only_not_condition_matched: The group fabricates square, rectangular, and cross-section pillar families with varying critical dimensions.
Historical SEMs discussed in the meeting showed bottom-profile distortion and loss or collapse of some small pillars.
Those historical observations are not identified as outcomes of the exact 2026-08-18 recipe and are not numerical targets.

tool.facility: Advanced Science Research Center at The Graduate Center, CUNY
tool.configuration_claim: Single-electrode RIE; the supplied recipe contains a table-RF setpoint and no independent ICP setpoint.

interpretation_guards: The 150 W value is a forward-power demand, not measured absorbed plasma power.
The 0 V minimum DC-bias field is a recipe constraint, not the achieved negative self-bias.
The 10 s total-time field belongs to RF stabilization, not the 20 minute etch duration.
Feed flow fractions are not wafer radical or ion flux fractions.
No SEM or measured depth for this exact condition was available when this manifest was frozen.
